name: vsphere-mcp
description: Read-only vCenter inventory for migration planning: blockers, snapshots, per-core licence exposure and Proxmox mapping, as JSON an agent can use.

vsphere_username.title: VSPHERE_USERNAME
vsphere_username.description: vCenter SSO user, e.g. readonly@vsphere.local. A Read-Only role is enough.

vsphere_tls_fingerprint.title: VSPHERE_TLS_FINGERPRINT
vsphere_tls_fingerprint.description: Only for a self-signed vCenter certificate: its SHA-256 fingerprint (comma-separate several). Leave empty for a trusted certificate.

vsphere_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
vsphere_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to vCenter. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Optional. Binds the MCP server to one saved client profile. Leave blank for the default.

vsphere_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
vsphere_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools. vCenter is only ever read; the tools that write this CLI's own files (learnings, playbooks, the local store, exports) act only with confirm set to true, and this switch hides them. Leave blank.

vsphere_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
vsphere_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to vCenter and nothing is written to the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

vsphere_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP bearer token (unused)
vsphere_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
